# Root help separates inherited flags and store-scoped command families.
exec card --help
stdout '^Global flags$'
stdout '^Mail$'
stdout 'mail subscribe'
stdout '^Leases$'
stdout 'lease acquire'
stdout 'Running locally'
stdout 'version'
! stdout 'Mail and leases'

# Subcommand help separates local and inherited flags.
exec card create --help
stdout '^Flags:$'
stdout '^Global flags$'
